correctness.rationale: Using the eight precise Kunz inequalities, reconstruct the Apéry maximality table: the middle consecutive residue pair (2,3) is impossible; the (1,2) and (3,4) cases yield exactly U=(c+d+1,c+d+1,c,d), 1<=d<=c<=2d+1, and V=(a,b,a+b,a+b), 1<=a<=b<=2a. Their direct converses, genus/Frobenius data, strict e=4 boundaries, integer interval counts and N_5(G)=G^2/54+O(G) follow. Independent full enumeration of 32,065 Kunz-valid tuples of genus <=60 found exactly 88 perfect type-two, 57 e=4, all within those families; finite tests do not prove all genera.
residual_risks: Finite independent genus<=60 validation is not an infinite proof; reliance on standard Kunz/Apéry maximality characterization.
